title: Get your tickets to the Pride Comedy Night at Toynbee Hall on Friday 28th June
intro: We’re celebrating Pride Month with a night of comedy raising money to help us build a fairer future.

image.alt: Get your tickets to the Pride Comedy Night at Toynbee Hall on Friday 28th June — Toynbee Hall

sections.text: A night of comedy to raise money for a fairer future and an end to poverty, injustice and inequality.

Join us to celebrate Pride Month with a night of comedy to raise money for Toynbee Hall, in partnership with Aldgate Connect, and help us build a fairer future in East London and an end to poverty, injustice and inequality.
We have a fantastic line-up of some of the best up and coming comedians in the country including;

items: Britain’s Got Talent Finalist, Robert White
Winner of the Sydney Fringe Best in Comedy, Robyn Perkins
LGBTQ+ New Comedian of the Year 2022, Dane Buckley
Winner of Only Fans Comedy Award, Mary O’Connell

sections.text: Tickets cost £15 and all funds raised go to Toynbee Hall, a charity based in the East End of London since 1884. Toynbee Hall works alongside people facing poverty and injustice to build a fairer and happier East London. We provide vital support and work in partnership with local communities to tackle unfairness and ensure everyone has an equal chance to thrive.
Go to Eventbrite for tickets and info. Buy your tickets now.
